entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 5864135319959353600 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1), ICRS at epoch J2016.0, from the archived row src/objects/kn-cen/source/photometry/gaia-dr3-source.csv; cross-identification HIP 66383: https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=Gaia+DR3+5864135319959353600. Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, KN Cen: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 3747.6 +/- 159.8 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 3747.6 +/- 159.8 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.2272 +/- 0.0183 mas (same row, RUWE 1.03), 12.4 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -6.923, -1.383 mas/yr. Radial velocity: Gaia DR3 (same row): -39.72 +/- 5.84 km/s.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 171.6 +/- 5.8 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, KN Cen: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 171.6 +/- 5.8 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 119,382,120 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4875 +/- 226 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 112, Name='KN Cen', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 4875 +/- 226 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 5864135319959353600: 6 G-band harmonics of a 34.02846822286729 d period, peak-to-peak 0.876 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.01 of a cycle there.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 4,875 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.797 +/- 0.087 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffe4cb. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,875 K and log g 0.4 (u1 0.666, u2 0.097): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Published: log g 0.4 from 2023A&A...678A.195D; the 7 published values span log g 0.4 to 1.7, across which the limb law changes by at most 1.8% of the centre brightness.
